import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/notification/history/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const match = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim().match(/^[!！/#＃]?(?:我的通知|通知记录)(?:\s+(\d+))?$/);
  const page = Number(match?.[1] ?? 1);
  const footer = [{ label: '返回主页', command: '/我' }];

  if (!match || !Number.isSafeInteger(page) || page < 1) {
    md.addText('请输入 /我的通知 或 /我的通知 页码');
  } else {
    try {
      const result = await App({ uid: Number(e.uid), bid: e.UserId, page });

      md.addText('异步事件记录；查看不会领取奖励或处理申请。');
      md.addNewline();
      if (result.items.length === 0) {
        md.addText('本页暂无通知');
      }
      for (const item of result.items) {
        md.addText(dayjs(item.time).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'));
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(item.delivery);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(item.text);
        md.addNewline();
      }
      if (page > 1) {
        footer.push({ label: '上一页', command: `/我的通知 ${page - 1}` });
      }
      if (result.hasNext) {
        footer.push({ label: '下一页', command: `/我的通知 ${page + 1}` });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('通知记录查询失败', error);
      md.addText('通知记录暂时无法加载，请稍后再试。');
    }
  }
  await message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false, bid: e.UserId, title: `我的通知 · 第 ${page} 页`, content: md, footer }));
});
